summary.text: Mark Meirath is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 39 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Tanya Lakins is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Mark Meirath was born in Lincoln, Nebraska, graduated from Archbishop O'Hara High School and attended Northwest Missouri State University and William Jewell College.
His career experience includes owning a construction company and working as a branch manager and lender in banking.
Meirath was assigned to the House Elementary and Secondary Education Committee for 2025-2026.
